facts.fact: CIO reports Amazon Web Services launched its Africa (Cape Town) region (af-south-1, three Availability Zones) earlier in May 2020, serving customers from South Africa.
CIO states Microsoft Azure has cloud regions in Cape Town and Johannesburg, Microsoft having launched its region in the first quarter of 2019.

note: Google and Huawei described as not having built their own data centres, Oracle as entering later in 2020: not facts.
